provenance.existing: Design-quality signals are read from the existing balance model: thermal stability and power headroom come from check-design's evaluate, and part revisions come from design/components.json. Rework cost follows the candidate already recorded in docs/design-candidates.md.
provenance.new: Base failure rate, condition multipliers, quality-control effects, rework costs and refund rules are original game balance. They are not real defect statistics.
provenance.limits: A game balance model by part revision and operating condition. It never assigns reliability to a real brand name.

rules.neverBrandReputation: Failure depends on revision, operating condition and player quality control, never on brand name
rules.caughtByTesting: A failure is caught before delivery when the build is tested; otherwise it reaches the customer
rules.expectedValue: The economy model charges the expected rework cost per unit rather than rolling dice, so runs stay reproducible
rules.threeTestingTiers: 测试分成未测试、部分测试、完整测试三档，两档阈值都必须被实际使用

failureRate.note: A competent build in a new hand-assembly workshop starts at 4 percent, above a factory line; a thermally unstable or power-starved design multiplies from there

qualityControl.note: 测试台工时决定故障在工坊内被发现还是流出到客户：低于 0.5 小时等于没测，0.5 到 1 小时之间只拦下一部分，达到 1 小时才是完整测试

rework.note: Within the candidate range already recorded: 2-4 labour hours, 1-2 test hours, 40-100 consumables

arrivalDefect.note: A machine that reaches the customer faulty is refunded in full, costs logistics, and costs reputation through the customer model
arrivalDefect.reputationSource: customer-model.json 的 reputation.deliveredMissingRequirement，口碑只保留一处定义
